firstRun.title: Welcome to PokeHub
firstRun.intro: Choose the folder where the hub will keep the tools, runtimes and your projects. Everything lives inside it, organized like this:
firstRun.tree:
tools/      tools (DSPRE, melonDS, ...)
runtimes/   Java, portable Git, MSYS2
projects/   your hacks, each with base.nds, workspace/ and builds/
cache/      reused downloads
firstRun.hint: Suggestion: an empty folder on a drive with free space, e.g. D:\PokeHub. You can change it later by deleting %AppData%\PokeHub\settings.json.

hist.intro: Each version is a git commit in workspace/. Restoring brings every file back to that state; the current state is saved first as a new version, so nothing is lost.

feature.maps.text: Maps, events, scripts and headers with DSPRE, already pointed at the project workspace.
feature.trainers.text: Trainer teams, classes and items (native hub editor).
feature.encounters.text: Wild Pokémon per route: grass, surf, fishing and time of day.
feature.text.text: Dialogues, names and game messages in any text bank.
feature.pokedex.text: Areas where each Pokémon shows up in the Pokédex (morning, day, night).
feature.pokemon.text: Stats, moves and evolutions with PokEditor.
feature.graphics.text: Sprites, tiles and palettes with NitroPaint (Tinke is under Tools).
feature.audio.text: Music and sound effects with Nitro Studio 2.
feature.emulator.text: Packs the ROM and opens it in the chosen emulator. Same as the Test button on the top bar.
feature.models.text: Converts NSBMD models and animations with apicula.
feature.decomp.text: Builds the ROM from pret's source code. The first build takes about 50 min.
feature.randomizer.text: Shuffles Pokémon, items and trainers with Universal Randomizer ZX.
feature.files.text: Opens the ROM file by file with Tinke to extract and inspect.
project.intro: The base ROM is kept; the extracted workspace is what the tools edit.

patch.title: Patch
patch.createTip: Packs and writes a .bps in builds/ with the difference between the base ROM and yours. That is the file you distribute.
patch.applyTip: Applies a .bps to a clean ROM and creates a project from the result.

batch.tip: Rules applied to many trainers or tables at once, with a preview.

batch.heldItem: Give a held item to the whole team
batch.replaceSpeciesAll: Replace a species in every table
batch.applyHint: Apply writes to the workspace. To undo, use Versions.
feature.batch.text: Raise levels, swap species or give items to many trainers and routes at once, with a preview.
feature.patch.text: Writes a .bps with only your changes. Players apply it to a clean ROM.
